<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="22" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="330" y2="22" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="14" x2="334" y2="22" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="11" x2="338" y2="22" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="17" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="20" x2="353" y2="14" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="361" y="11" width="21" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="13" width="15" height="8" rx="2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="383" y="15" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,53 22,61 30,69" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="61" x2="42" y2="61" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="58" y="67" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Article</text>
    <circle cx="345" cy="60" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="60" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="60" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="84" x2="370" y2="84" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Publisher row -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="35" cy="111" r="15" fill="#CC0000"/>
    <text x="35" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">BBC</text>
    <text x="59" y="106" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">BBC News</text>
    <text x="59" y="124" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">6 hours ago · World</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="285" y="98" width="85" height="30" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="327.5" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Following</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Hero image -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="143" width="350" height="176" rx="6" fill="#111315"/>
    <rect x="20" y="143" width="350" height="176" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="181" r="17" fill="#FFD789"/>
    <polygon points="20,285 104,211 157,255 205,219 286,285" fill="#50545B"/>
    <polygon points="120,319 194,242 245,282 293,244 370,319" fill="#646464"/>
    <rect x="20" y="285" width="350" height="34" fill="#2A2C2F"/>
    <text x="34" y="307" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Ukraine conflict · Kyiv, Ukraine</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Headline and article metadata -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="351" font-family="Poppins" font-size="24" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Zelensky urges allies to</text>
    <text x="20" y="383" font-family="Poppins" font-size="24" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">tighten pressure on Russian oil</text>
    <text x="20" y="414" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">President says sanctions must be strengthened as</text>
    <text x="20" y="434" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Ukraine seeks a lasting path towards peace.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Author card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="454" width="350" height="62" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="20" y="452" width="350" height="62" rx="6" fill="#25272A"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="483" r="20" fill="#7B61FF"/>
    <text x="51" y="489" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">JM</text>
    <text x="82" y="478" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">James McKenzie</text>
    <text x="82" y="498" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">BBC News correspondent</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="286" y="469" width="67" height="29" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="319.5" y="488" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Follow</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Article text -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="546" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Ukraine's president has called for</text>
    <text x="20" y="570" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">stronger international action against Russia's</text>
    <text x="20" y="594" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">energy exports, saying oil revenues continue</text>
    <text x="20" y="618" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">to fund the war.</text>
    <text x="20" y="650" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Speaking after talks with European leaders,</text>
    <text x="20" y="674" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Volodymyr Zelensky said coordinated sanctions</text>
    <text x="20" y="698" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">could help bring the conflict closer to an end.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Engagement bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="716" width="390" height="58" fill="#25272A"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="716" x2="370" y2="716" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="744" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="749" x2="50" y2="754" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="57" y="749" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">24</text>
    <polygon points="121,738 126,743 121,748 116,743" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="136" y="749" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">8</text>
    <polyline points="205,741 205,749 211,749 211,754 222,744 211,734 211,739" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="230" y="749" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Share</text>
    <polygon points="321,735 331,735 331,752 321,752 321,735 326,735 326,748" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="341" y="749" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Save</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#1C1E21"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="44,793 54,785 64,793 62,793 62,805 48,805 48,793" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="54" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="132" cy="794" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="138" y1="800" x2="145" y2="807" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="132" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="211" y="785" width="16" height="19" rx="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <polyline points="215,790 223,790 223,800 215,800" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <text x="219" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="310" cy="791" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="310" cy="802" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="310" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
